# Interview Preparation Guide – Backend Engineer (Fintech Startup, Bangalore) ## 1. Role snapshot Backend Engineer at a fintech startup in Bangalore responsible for designing, building, and maintaining high‑throughput RESTful services using **Python** and **FastAPI**, backed by **PostgreSQL**, containerised with **Docker**, and deployed on **AWS**. The role emphasizes low‑latency write paths, solid testing practices, and collaboration with product and data teams in a fast‑moving startup environment. *Source:* [Backend Engineer – Meyrahkee Advisors (Cutshort)](https://cutshort.io/job/Backend-Engineer-Bengaluru-Bangalore-Meyrahkee-Advisors-t7EbjIEU) ## 2. Must-have skills | Skill | Why it matters (per sources) | Helpful link | |-------|-----------------------------|--------------| | **Python** | Core language for service logic; referenced in job posts and algorithm repo. | [TheAlgorithms/Python](https://github.com/TheAlgorithms/Python) | | **FastAPI** | Primary framework for REST API development; highlighted in job ads. | [FastAPI Interview Preparation](https://github.com/rohanmistry231/Fast-API-Interview-Preparation) | | **PostgreSQL** | Main relational store; performance and optimisation are key. | (system‑design primer covers DB optimisation) | | **Docker** | Used for containerising services; mentioned in job descriptions. | (no dedicated link – see job posts) | | **AWS** | Deployment platform; services such as EC2, RDS, Lambda, etc., are expected. | (system‑design primer covers AWS deployment) | | **REST API design** | Core interface for external and internal clients. | (FastAPI prep repo) | | **Unit testing** | Ensures reliability of individual components. | (FastAPI prep repo) | | **Integration testing** | Validates end‑to‑end flows; part of testing strategy. | (FastAPI prep repo) | | **High write throughput optimization** | Critical for fintech transaction processing. | [System Design Primer](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer) | | **Fintech industry knowledge** | Understanding of payments, compliance, and domain‑specific concerns. | [Fintech Interview Questions (Glassdoor)](https://www.glassdoor.co.in/Interview/Fintech-Interview-Questions-E816003.htm) | | **Bangalore tech startup ecosystem** | Awareness of local talent, culture, and market dynamics. | (job postings mention Bangalore) | | **Typical backend engineer interview process** | Helps you anticipate stages (screen, coding, system design, behavioural). | [Fintech Software Developer Interview Questions (Glassdoor)](https://www.glassdoor.co.in/Interview/Fintech-Software-Developer-Interview-Questions-EI_IE816003.0,7_KO8,26.htm) | | **AWS services for deployment** | Specific services (e.g., RDS, Elastic Beanstalk, ECS) likely discussed. | [System Design Primer](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer) | | **PostgreSQL performance optimization** | Indexing, query planning, connection pooling, read‑replica strategies. | [System Design Primer](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer) | ## 3. Prep plan (2‑week intensive + 1‑week review) | Week | Focus | Activities (based on material) | |------|-------|---------------------------------| | **1** | **Language & Framework** | - Review Python fundamentals using *TheAlgorithms/Python* (data structures, OOP).
- Work through the *FastAPI Interview Preparation* repo: build a small CRUD API, practice dependency injection, Pydantic models, and async endpoints. | | **2** | **Databases, Containers & Cloud** | - Study PostgreSQL optimisation topics from the *System Design Primer* (indexing, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, connection pooling).
- Run a local PostgreSQL instance in Docker; experiment with bulk inserts and write‑throughput tuning.
- Explore AWS services (RDS, EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda) via the primer’s AWS section; deploy the FastAPI app to a Docker container on ECS or Elastic Beanstalk. | | **3** | **Testing, API Design & Domain** | - Add unit tests (pytest) and integration tests (TestClient) to the FastAPI project.
- Review REST best practices (versioning, error handling, pagination) from the FastAPI prep material.
- Read selected fintech interview question sets (Glassdoor, Cleverprep) to grasp domain‑specific behavioural and product‑sense questions. | | **4** (optional) | **Mock interviews & review** | - Conduct timed coding screens (LeetCode‑style easy/medium) focusing on Python.
- Practice system design questions around high‑throughput payment processing (use primer as guide).
- Review answers to the fintech question lists; prepare STAR stories for behavioural rounds. | **Key links to revisit:** - Python: https://github.com/TheAlgorithms/Python - FastAPI prep: https://github.com/rohanmistry231/Fast-API-Interview-Preparation - System design primer (covers PostgreSQL, AWS, high write throughput): https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer - Fintech interview questions: https://www.glassdoor.co.in/Interview/Fintech-Interview-Questions-E816003.htm - Affirm backend questions (example of tech‑focused fintech interview): https://www.cleverprep.com/companies/affirm/backend-software-engineer ## 4.
